description.en: Locks the map's BGM so it won't automatically change/restart (e.g. while a script is manually managing sound), until the map is left.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Prevent the map's BGM from automatically changing
CMND_SND_LOCK_MAP_BGM();
